title: Our American Story: Spotlight on Kurt Konwinski
summary: Watch as Coca-Cola Consolidated Teammate Kurt Konwinski shares his personal connections to the Coca-Cola brand.
body_markdown:
Every Coca-Cola story is personal and, in the newest edition of “Our American Story” series, Teammate Kurt Konwinski shares meaningful moments that have shaped his connection to Coca-Cola.


As we continue celebrating America250, we’re honored to spotlight the people behind our brands and the stories that reflect the connections, traditions and shared experiences that bring communities together across America. ⬇️
